_sequencing_note: Arrivals: GCRR (Lanzarote) via TERTO, GMMN (Casablanca Mohammed V) via MARJA and SALCA. The LoA levels (FL250) and spacing (10 NM in trail) are placeholders until the real letters of agreement are entered.

rad_routes._note: Direct routings published in the RAD (Route Availability Document), not drawn on the ENR charts. Listed in their published direction.
rad_routes._two_way_note: SUBAL-IBALU-SALCA and BEXAL-IBALU-SALCA are also used westbound (ODAXA-SALCA-IBALU-SUBAL/BEXAL) by departures from Casablanca to the USA and Canada (user). The other RAD routings are one-way.

_entry_exit_note: FRA designators from ENR 4.4: E = entry only (KORNO, RUNAX, VASTO, DESUM), X = exit only (TERTO, TIGGI, AKUDA), EX = both. All routes through VASTO are northbound.

external_points._note: Points in the neighbouring sectors (Lisboa, Sevilla/Madrid, Casablanca, Canarias, Madeira). They are not transfer points; flight plans use them before the entry and after the exit point, and the controller can clear aircraft direct to them. Points marked provisional have estimated positions.

onward_routes._note: Points flown before the entry / after the exit point, by transfer point and destination (exits) or departure (entries). Rules are tried in order; the first whose conditions match is used. 'options' are alternative point sequences with relative weights (picked per callsign, reproducibly). 'by_runway' picks by the runway in use at the destination. Destination groups are ICAO location-indicator prefixes (2 letters) or full codes.

separation_minima._note: Radar separation minimum applied in the Agadir CTA (user). Scenarios can override it with {"separation": {"horizontal_nm": N}}.

descent_destinations._note: Traffic to these aerodromes descends in or just after the CTA: pilots may request descent, levels below the sector or the LoA can be given (after coordination), and the semicircular rule does not apply to their descent levels.

cpdlc._note: CPDLC data link: our ATSU address and the adjacent units (name for CONTACT / MONITOR, frequency, data link address). The frequencies of the adjacent units are training values, not the published ones: replace them with yours.
cpdlc.name: AGADIR

capacity_per_hour._note: Declared sector capacities, Agadir ACC (flights per hour). Keys: controlled sectors, sorted, joined with '+'. WW = West band-boxed (WN+WS), OCE = Oceanic band-boxed (ON+OS = OCN+OCS), WW-OCE = the whole CTA.

ctas._note: The FIR GMMM holds two control areas: CTA AGADIR (ACC Agadir, sectors ON / WN / WS / OS) and CTA CASABLANCA (ACC Casablanca, sectors N / E / C / SS, ENR 2.1). A scenario controls sectors of one of them; the other one is drawn and its sectors are the neighbouring unit.

CASABLANCA.name: Casablanca CTA (Casablanca FIR GMMM)
CASABLANCA.sequencing_note: Arrivals leave the CTA CASABLANCA downwards into the TMAs at a fix on the TMA boundary: GMMN at LAKAM (from Agadir West North via MARJA / SALCA), RAVOL (from the west via NISBA, from the south via MOKRI) and BISMI (from the east on UR975, from the north on UB11); GMME at FAHIM (from the north) and ENNAV (from the east); GMMX at MABAP (UR722 / UB11 / UN869 from the north) and OBOGA (UG850 from the east); GMAD at AGALI (UR724 / UH400), OLOMA (UG850) and TEKNA (UA600 from the south); GMMZ at MAXOR (UJ744) and LARAP (UG664). The letter of agreement asks for arrivals cleared to FL200 at the fix (they may still be descending) and 10 NM in trail: placeholders until the unit's real letters of agreement are entered. Departures from these aerodromes call climbing to FL190 (released by approach) and ask for their final level.

published_areas._note: AIP Maroc ENR 5.1 prohibited (GMP), restricted (GMR) and danger (GMD) areas, loaded into every scenario of this airspace. Prohibited areas are active (H24); restricted and danger areas are published inactive and a scenario activates them with "published_areas": {"GMD25": true} or {"GMD25": {"active": false, "schedule": [{"time": 600, "active": true}]}}. Limits as flight levels (GND / SFC / MSL = 0, UNL = 999; feet and metres converted).
